decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink mix sits outside the firm's core technology direction, but a consumer product listed on the website costs little to keep, so the option stays open while its market response is still unclear after one year.
Modular extensions complement the waste-to-energy plants at low incremental cost and keep open the option to scale with customer demand, so dropping them this early is not justified.
As a flagship with its own page, the waste-oil-to-energy plant is the firm's main growth option, and one year of results cannot resolve the uncertainty enough to justify abandoning it.
The plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is a flagship in a growing field with high strategic upside, so the firm keeps this option open while technical and market uncertainty resolves.
